description: Daily P&L per strategy of the DE-LU day-ahead + continuous-intraday backtest (1 MW / 2 MWh). pnl_eur = da_revenue - da_fees + id_revenue - id_fees - slippage - degradation; revenue_eur = pnl_eur + degradation_eur. Daily (not quarter-hourly) on purpose: quarter-hour ledgers would let readers back out the ID AEP index, which is not redistributable.

strategies.da_id_reopt_da: DA + ID: re-optimise at DA prices

intraday_price: ID AEP (netztransparenz.de) as a VWAP-execution proxy; DA-price fallback when undefined

data_sources.intraday: netztransparenz.de Index Ausgleichsenergiepreis, built locally under data/raw/intraday (not redistributed; reproduction requires the German TSOs' prior written consent)
